summary: To see all variables for a host, including facts, run ansible -m debug -a "var=hostvars['hostname']" localhost; facts appear only if gathered earlier or cached.
questions: How do I see every variable Ansible knows for one host?
Why are facts missing from hostvars?

answer_card.title: Show all variables for a host
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible -m debug -a "var=hostvars['hostname']" localhost
```

Facts are only included if they were gathered earlier in the play or you use a fact cache.
